before.requirement: Establish ProcGlobal before InitProcess; the old BaseInit route calls InitCommunication for shared memory and semaphore setup.
before.reason: The unchanged harness calls BaseInit before InitProcess. Before the change, BaseInit's documented shared memory setup call occupied that position.

after.requirement: Establish ProcGlobal explicitly before InitProcess because BaseInit no longer performs shared memory setup.
after.reason: The same harness calls BaseInit then InitProcess, with no shared memory setup between them. After the change, BaseInit no longer calls InitCommunication; InitProcess rejects NULL ProcGlobal.

claims.reason: The harness sequence is fixed across both versions. Removing InitCommunication from BaseInit changes its ProcGlobal prerequisite from satisfied to unsatisfied. The new MyProc assertions may fail earlier in an assertion-enabled build, but they do not supply ProcGlobal.

missing_information: This timing turn covers only frozen obligation c2; it does not establish complete coverage of every obligation in g0015 and g0020.
